Execute step A3 of the build plan at `~/Dev/zimmerMANN-skills/.runs/SFCC-83+84/plan.md` — read that file's A3 section (search for `### A3 — Card mapper utility`) in full; this prompt gives you precise, pre-researched decisions the plan itself leaves more open, so follow this prompt's specifics where it's more concrete than the plan text.

## Files to create (only these two)

- `overrides/app/utils/recentlyViewedCard.ts`
- `overrides/app/utils/recentlyViewedCard.test.ts`

## Required reading before writing anything

1. `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/productInfo.ts` — the established house pattern for this exact kind of mapper (injected `FormatPrice`, no React/react-intl, real SDK types where they exist, hand-rolled narrow types only for genuinely-unexported shapes with a why-comment). Mirror its conventions closely.
2. Read (via `git show feature/zimmproductcard-live-demo:overrides/app/pages/home/liveProductCardDemoMapper.ts` — do NOT check out that branch, do NOT import from it, it's on a different branch and doesn't exist here) the prior-art demo mapper for the general shape of this kind of transform (alt-never-empty fallback, image-group filtering, no-currency-no-guess price handling). That file deliberately hand-rolled types because it's throwaway-demo scope — yours is production scope, so you must use real SDK types instead where `productInfo.ts` shows they exist (see below).
3. `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/use-einstein.js` — read `fetchRecProductDetails` (search for that name) to see the *exact* real input shape this mapper receives, already merged: `{...rec, ...product, productId: rec.id, image: {disBaseLink: rec.imageUrl, alt: rec.productName}}`. `product` here is a real Commerce API product resource fetched via `getProducts` with `expand: ['availability','links','promotions','options','images','prices','variations']`.

## The real SDK type to import (already verified present)

`commerce-sdk-isomorphic` exports `ShopperProductsTypes.Product` (and `.ImageGroup`, `.Image`) — confirmed directly in `node_modules/commerce-sdk-isomorphic/lib/index.esm.d.ts`. Relevant fields on `Product`: `id: string` (required), `name?: string`, `price?: number`, `currency?: string`, `imageGroups?: Array<ImageGroup>`. `ImageGroup = {images: Array<Image>, variationAttributes?, viewType: string}`. `Image = {alt?: string, disBaseLink?: string, link: string (required), title?: string}`.

Import this type directly (`import type {ShopperProductsTypes} from 'commerce-sdk-isomorphic'`) — do not hand-roll a duplicate `Product`/`ImageGroup`/`Image` shape. The *only* genuinely-unexported extra fields are the two `fetchRecProductDetails` bolts on: `productId` and the singular `image`. Model the mapper's input type as:

```ts
type RecentlyViewedProduct = ShopperProductsTypes.Product & {
  /** Set by use-einstein.js's fetchRecProductDetails to rec.id. Guaranteed present and equal to
   *  Product.id for every entry that function produces (it already filters out any rec with no
   *  matching product before this shape exists at all) — read this rather than `.id` only
   *  because it's the field the real runtime hook explicitly produces this way. */
  productId: string;
  /** Same function's own quick single-reference image (Einstein's own rec.imageUrl/rec.productName),
   *  distinct from the full product's own `imageGroups` array below — used as a fallback only
   *  when imageGroups filtering comes up empty (see the mapper's own image-selection logic). */
  image?: { disBaseLink?: string; alt?: string };
};
```

## Image selection — a specific, verified decision, not a guess

Prefer `filterImageGroups(product.imageGroups, {viewType: 'medium', variationValues: {}})` (real signature confirmed in `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/product-utils.js` — `(imageGroups = [], filters) => ...`, filters by `viewType` and optionally one `variationValues` attribute/value pair; pass an empty `variationValues` object since a Recently Viewed rec is already one specific product, not a search hit needing a variant pick like the demo mapper's `resolveDemoVariant` — do not port that variant-picking logic, it doesn't apply here) — take `[0]?.images` from the filtered result. **Fall back to the top-level `image: {disBaseLink, alt}` field** (built via a synthetic single-entry array) only if `imageGroups` filtering produces nothing usable. This reconciles the plan's two seemingly-different instructions (reuse `filterImageGroups`, *and* the input includes a flat `image` field) — the flat field is Einstein's own convenience shape and the correct fallback, not the primary source, per `AGENTS.md`'s image-sizing guidance (never serve a full-resolution/arbitrary-sized image at thumbnail size — `filterImageGroups` with `viewType: 'medium'` gets a properly-sized image; Einstein's raw `imageUrl` might be sized for anything).

Per SFCC-83 AC 3 ("the product's index image" — singular), only ever return **one** image (`primaryImage`), never `hoverImage`/`images` — those two fields should always be `undefined`/omitted from this mapper's return shape entirely (not just empty). Don't port the demo mapper's multi-image/hover-image logic; it doesn't apply here at all.

`ZimmProductCardMediaImage.alt` (imported type) is required and must be non-empty. Mirror the demo mapper's own fallback exactly: `img.alt?.trim() || product.name` (no colour suffix needed here — this variation doesn't render an attributes line anyway, and there's no confirmed colour/variant context for this specific product the way the demo mapper had one).

## href — verified against the already-shipping precedent, not guessed

`overrides/app/components/product-tile/index.jsx` (wait — check the REAL base file, not an override: `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/product-tile/index.jsx`) — confirmed it builds its own PDP link via bare `productUrlBuilder({id: productId})` (`app/utils/url`), with **no manual site-prefixing of its own**. This is the exact same context (a product tile inside a recommendation rail) already shipping correctly in production across the other five/six unrelated rails today. Match this precedent exactly: `productUrlBuilder({id: product.productId})`, no site-prefix logic of your own to invent.

## Price — deliberately narrow scope, state it as a decision not an omission

Map `currentPrice` only (via the injected `formatPrice(product.price, product.currency)`, skipping formatting entirely — returning `undefined` — when either is missing/not a number, matching `productInfo.ts`'s own "no hardcoded fallback currency" comment). **Do not attempt was/now sale-price detection** (no `originalPrice`) — that requires `getPriceData`-style pricebook logic `productInfo.ts` sources from a separate, more elaborate utility this merged Einstein shape doesn't have available; the plan's own A3 pass criteria never asks for it, only for "price without currency" handling. State this as a deliberate scope decision in the module's own docblock (one sentence, matching this file's established documentation culture — see `productInfo.ts` for the tone), not a silent gap.

## `name` — required, and it matters even though A2's variation never visually shows it

Return `null` for the whole mapping when `product.name` is missing (same "no productName, no usable card" gate the demo mapper uses, just off the real SDK field name — it's `name`, not `productName`; `rec.productName` is Einstein's own separate, likely-redundant copy and should NOT be preferred over the SDK's own authoritative field — the upstream hook's own filter step already guarantees a real matched product exists for every surviving rec, so `product.name` should always be populated in practice, but guard for it anyway per this mapper's own null-safety contract). This field feeds `ZimmProductCard`'s `VisuallyHidden` accessible-name text for the `recentlyViewed` variation (SFCC-83, already shipped in A2) — it is not merely cosmetic here even though nothing visually renders it.

## Return shape — deliberately excludes `headingLevel` and `variation`

Return type: `Pick<ZimmProductCardBaseProps, 'id' | 'href' | 'name' | 'primaryImage' | 'currentPrice'> | null` (import `ZimmProductCardBaseProps`/`ZimmProductCardImage` as types from `../components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard`, matching the demo mapper's own import path pattern one directory shallower). Do **not** include `headingLevel` or `variation` — both are render-context decisions belonging to A5 (the not-yet-built rail organism), which will supply `headingLevel` uniformly for every card it renders and add `variation: 'recentlyViewed'` itself when spreading this mapper's output into `<ZimmProductCard>`. A pure data mapper choosing a heading level would be conflating a data concern with a layout one.

`id` in the return maps from `product.productId` (not `.id` — see the type comment above for why, though they're guaranteed equal for every surviving rec).

## Function naming

Name the exported function `selectRecentlyViewedCard`, matching this codebase's established naming convention for this exact kind of mapper (`productInfo.ts`'s own `selectPdpProductInfo`). Export the `FormatPrice` type too (identical shape to `productInfo.ts`'s own: `(amount: number, currency: string) => string`) and the `RecentlyViewedProduct` input type.

## Tests (`recentlyViewedCard.test.ts`)

Per the plan's own pass criteria, cover: happy path (real name, real imageGroups, real price+currency → correct mapped output, including that `href` is the bare `/product/...` path with no site-prefix and that `headingLevel`/`variation`/`hoverImage`/`images` are all absent from the returned object); missing `name` → `null`; missing/empty `imageGroups` with no usable fallback `image` either → still returns *something* usable rather than a broken card (decide and document whether that means `null` or a card with a placeholder-safe image — whichever you choose, the returned `alt` must never be empty per the type's own contract, so pick the option that can't violate that); single image present only via the fallback `image` field, no `imageGroups` at all → correct fallback path exercised; price present but currency missing (or vice versa) → `currentPrice` is `undefined`, `formatPrice` is never called with a guessed value. No React, no react-intl, no hook import anywhere in either file (`conventions.md` > Utilities) — confirm via `grep -n "^import" recentlyViewedCard.ts` that nothing named `react`/`react-intl`/`use[A-Z]` appears.

## Pass criteria (verify all before reporting)

- `grep -n "^import react\|from 'react'\|from \"react-intl\"\|use[A-Z]" overrides/app/utils/recentlyViewedCard.ts` — no hook/React/react-intl imports.
- `npx tsc --noEmit` clean.
- `npm run test` green, including your new test file.
- `npm run lint` — compare your own count against a fresh baseline you check first (26 problems / 5 errors / 21 warnings as of the last verified run); zero new problems.
- Confirm `ShopperProductsTypes.Product`/`.ImageGroup`/`.Image` are genuinely imported (not hand-rolled) — `grep -n "ShopperProductsTypes\|from 'commerce-sdk-isomorphic'" recentlyViewedCard.ts`.
- Every test case that expects a *failure-shaped* input (missing name, missing images, missing currency) should be a real assertion against a real call, not a trivial always-true check.

## Scope boundary

Only the two files named above. Do not touch `zimmProductCard/*`, `product-utils.js`, `url.js`, or anything else. Do not stage or commit — the orchestrating skill handles that after review.

When done, report: the final file contents, confirmation of every pass criterion with real command output, and anything you found ambiguous or had to make a judgment call on that isn't already resolved above.

**Produced:** 2026-09-06 · **Gate:** `findings.md` (four passes, cleared at the 2026-09-06 adjudication)
**Base branch:** `feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component` (PR #85, open, unmerged)

## 1. Goal statement

Build the Recently Viewed rail and its full-history page per **SFCC-83** and **SFCC-84** (ACs in Jira
`customfield_10231`), designed in **`Zimmermann_Design_System_2026` component set `40000587:38471`**
(Desktop `40000307:12444`, Tablet `40000730:13363`, Mobile `40000538:25030` — all authoritative,
corroborated by PDP-template instances `7998:13508` / `8272:28947`), with SFCC-84's page from the
**provisional** `Zimmermann_Designs` `3332:35655` — following `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md`
(token hierarchy) and `.claude/rules/components.md` (container/presentational split), and extending
**PR #85 / SFCC-236's** `ZimmProductCard` family via a **new `VARIATION_CONFIG` entry** (not a new
card), a **copy-first override of `recommended-products/`**, and **co-located `<name>.css.ts`**
recipes registered in `theme/components/index.ts`.

Scope follows `.docs/prd/search.md` §7.4 (PDP + Cart). **PLP is out**; SFCC-83 AC 9 knowingly not met.
**No consent gating** (development-phase carve-out, Marcel 2026-09-06) — must be stated in both PR
bodies; must not reach production.

## 2. Scale call

### Architecture fork — resolved: override `recommended-products/`, which removes the Cart port

Verified directly at `node_modules/@salesforce/pwa-kit-dev/configs/webpack/overrides-plugin.js`.
`isFromExtends` returns true when the request names `@salesforce/retail-react-app` **and the issuing
file is not itself inside `overrides/`**. The plugin's own comment (lines 116–127): *"This will return
true if the issuer is a file in a base template... This allow the base template to import from
overrides."* Implementation: `this.extends.includes(pkgName) && !filepath.includes(issuerPath)`.

Base Cart imports at `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/pages/cart/index.jsx:36`:
`import RecommendedProducts from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/recommended-products'`
— a package-path import issued from a base file, so it **is** redirected once our override exists.
Base Cart is itself loaded by base `routes.jsx` via a relative `import('./pages/cart')`, which is not
redirected — so base Cart keeps rendering and picks up our override for free.

**Consequence: the ~2,460-line Cart copy-first (`index.jsx` 1515 + 8 real partials ≈ 948) is not
required.** This departed from adjudication item #10 ("we only have to copy-first for cart"), in the
direction of *less* work. **APPROVED by Marcel, 2026-09-06**, on the evidence that this is already the
dominant pattern in this repo: nine component overrides shadow base paths and are reached purely by
the resolver (`icons` at 64 base import sites — and mandated by AGENTS.md — `responsive` 12,
`product-view` 6, `drawer-menu`/`list-menu` 2 each, `header`/`footer` 1 each). The single page port
(`product-detail`) exists only because base `routes.jsx` loads pages by *relative* import, which the
resolver never redirects — a constraint that does not apply to components. Open Question 5 is closed.

**Caveat:** this is a *build-time webpack* resolver. It runs in the dev server and production build
only — **not** Storybook (`.storybook/main.js` aliases straight to `node_modules`) and **not** Vitest.
So the Cart behaviour cannot be proven by any automated test in this repo; it must be checked in the
running app. That is why A1's pause is a hard gate.

Cost of this choice: the override module loads at **four base import sites serving eight rails**, not
five as an earlier draft of this plan stated:

1	/**
2	 * Maps one Recently Viewed recommendation onto the subset of `ZimmProductCard` props the
3	 * `recentlyViewed` variation (SFCC-83) actually renders.
4	 *
5	 * Input is exactly what `use-einstein.js`'s `fetchRecProductDetails` produces (search that name
6	 * in `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/hooks/use-einstein.js`): an Einstein rec
7	 * merged with its matching Commerce API product, fetched via `getProducts` with `expand:
8	 * ['availability', 'links', 'promotions', 'options', 'images', 'prices', 'variations']` —
9	 * `{...rec, ...product, productId: rec.id, image: {disBaseLink: rec.imageUrl, alt:
10	 * rec.productName}}`.
11	 *
12	 * Modelled on `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/productInfo.ts` — no React/react-intl import,
13	 * `formatPrice` injected as a parameter so this module stays independently testable — and on the
14	 * general shape of `liveProductCardDemoMapper.ts` (`feature/zimmproductcard-live-demo`, not this
15	 * branch — read for its approach, not imported). Unlike that demo mapper, this is a production
16	 * path: real `commerce-sdk-isomorphic` SDK types are used wherever they exist (AGENTS.md > Type
17	 * Definitions), and only the two fields the SDK doesn't export (`productId`, the flat Einstein
18	 * `image`) are hand-rolled, each with its own why-comment below.
19	 *
20	 * Deliberately narrow scope, stated here rather than left as a silent gap: this mapper only ever
21	 * returns `currentPrice` (an active selling price). It does not attempt was/now sale-price
22	 * detection (`originalPrice`) — that needs `getPriceData`-style pricebook logic
23	 * (`productInfo.ts`'s own `PdpSourcePrice`) that this merged Einstein shape has no equivalent of,
24	 * and the `recentlyViewed` variation renders no price at all today (see
25	 * `zimmProductCard/index.tsx`'s `recentlyViewed` `VARIATION_CONFIG` row — `showContent: false`).
26	 * Mapping `currentPrice` anyway costs nothing and means a future consumer of this same mapper
27	 * (e.g. a variation that does render price) isn't blocked on this file being revisited.
28	 */
29	import type { ShopperProductsTypes } from 'commerce-sdk-isomorphic';
30	import { filterImageGroups } from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/product-utils';
31	import { productUrlBuilder } from '@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/url';
32	import type { ZimmProductCardBaseProps, ZimmProductCardImage } from '../components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard';
33	
34	/**
35	 * The real Commerce API `Product` (`commerce-sdk-isomorphic`'s own `ShopperProductsTypes.Product`
36	 * — not hand-rolled), plus the two fields `fetchRecProductDetails` bolts on that have no SDK
37	 * equivalent:
38	 */
39	export type RecentlyViewedProduct = ShopperProductsTypes.Product & {
40	  /** Set by `fetchRecProductDetails` to `rec.id`. Guaranteed present and equal to `Product.id`
41	   *  for every entry that function produces (it already filters out any rec with no matching
42	   *  product before this shape exists at all) — read this rather than `.id` only because it's
43	   *  the field the real runtime hook explicitly produces this way. */
44	  productId: string;
45	  /** The same function's own quick single-reference image (Einstein's own `rec.imageUrl`/
46	   *  `rec.productName`), distinct from the full product's own `imageGroups` array below — used
47	   *  as a fallback only when `imageGroups` filtering comes up empty. See `selectPrimaryImage`. */
48	  image?: { disBaseLink?: string; alt?: string };
49	};
50	
51	/** Formats a bare amount for the storefront. Injected so this module stays free of react-intl,
52	 *  mirroring `productInfo.ts`'s own `FormatPrice` shape. */
53	export type FormatPrice = (amount: number, currency: string) => string;
54	
55	/**
56	 * The subset of `ZimmProductCardBaseProps` this mapper populates. Deliberately excludes
57	 * `headingLevel` and `variation` — both are render-context decisions belonging to the rail
58	 * organism that consumes this mapper's output (SFCC-83's A5 step), which supplies `headingLevel`
59	 * uniformly for every card it renders and adds `variation: 'recentlyViewed'` itself when
60	 * spreading this output into `<ZimmProductCard>`. A pure data mapper choosing a heading level
61	 * would conflate a data concern with a layout one. Also excludes `hoverImage`/`images` — this
62	 * mapper only ever returns one image (`primaryImage`); see `selectPrimaryImage`'s own docblock
63	 * for why.
64	 */
65	export type RecentlyViewedCard = Pick<
66	  ZimmProductCardBaseProps,
67	  'id' | 'href' | 'name' | 'primaryImage' | 'currentPrice'
68	>;
69	
70	/** The correctly-sized product image view, per AGENTS.md's image-sizing guidance: never serve an
71	 *  arbitrary-sized image at thumbnail size. Named rather than inlined per conventions.md's
72	 *  no-magic-strings rule — this is a real, semantic SFCC image `viewType` key. */
73	const MEDIUM_VIEW_TYPE = 'medium';
74	
75	/**
76	 * Resolves the one image this mapper ever returns. `hoverImage`/`images` are never populated —
77	 * SFCC-83 AC 3 asks for "the product's index image" (singular), and the `recentlyViewed`
78	 * variation renders neither a hover-swap nor a gallery (see `zimmProductCard/index.tsx`'s
79	 * `recentlyViewed` row: `showHoverImageSwap: false`, and its render branch never forwards
80	 * `images` at all).
81	 *
82	 * Prefers `filterImageGroups` at `viewType: 'medium'` (a real, correctly-sized product image) —
83	 * `variationValues` is deliberately empty: a Recently Viewed rec is already one specific product,
84	 * not a search hit needing a variant pick the way `liveProductCardDemoMapper.ts`'s own
85	 * `resolveDemoVariant` handles, so that logic does not apply here. Falls back to Einstein's own
86	 * flat `image` field only when that filtering produces nothing usable — see
87	 * `RecentlyViewedProduct.image`'s own comment for what that field is.
88	 *
89	 * @returns `null` when neither source has a usable `src`. `ZimmProductCardMediaImage.alt` is
90	 *   required and non-empty, so there is no safe placeholder card to build without a real image —
91	 *   a card with an invented placeholder `src` would need an asset this codebase has no confirmed
92	 *   token or precedent for, so "no usable image" is treated the same as "no usable name" in
93	 *   `selectRecentlyViewedCard` below: a hard gate that yields no card at all. Returning `null`
94	 *   here is the only option that structurally cannot violate the non-empty-`alt` contract, since
95	 *   there is no returned object for `alt` to be empty on.
96	 */
97	const selectPrimaryImage = (product: RecentlyViewedProduct, productName: string): ZimmProductCardImage | null => {
98	  const filteredGroups = filterImageGroups(product.imageGroups ?? [], {
99	    viewType: MEDIUM_VIEW_TYPE,
100	    variationValues: {},
101	  }) as ShopperProductsTypes.ImageGroup[];
102	  const [groupImage] = filteredGroups[0]?.images ?? [];
103	
104	  const src = groupImage ? groupImage.disBaseLink || groupImage.link : product.image?.disBaseLink;
105	  if (!src) return null;
106	
107	  // ZimmProductCardMediaImage.alt is required and non-empty (unlike base ProductTile's
108	  // decorative alt: '' convention) — mirrors liveProductCardDemoMapper.ts's own fallback exactly.
109	  const alt = (groupImage ? groupImage.alt : product.image?.alt)?.trim() || productName;
110	  return { src, alt };
111	};
112	
113	/**
114	 * @param product - The merged Einstein rec + Commerce API product `fetchRecProductDetails`
115	 *   produces, or `undefined`/`null` while that data is not yet available.
116	 * @param formatPrice - Currency formatter, normally `intl.formatNumber`.
117	 * @returns Props for the `recentlyViewed` `ZimmProductCard` variation, or `null` when the rec has
118	 *   no usable name or no usable image — never a broken card, never a throw.
119	 */
120	export const selectRecentlyViewedCard = (
121	  product: RecentlyViewedProduct | undefined | null,
122	  formatPrice: FormatPrice,
123	): RecentlyViewedCard | null => {
124	  if (!product?.name) return null;
125	
126	  const primaryImage = selectPrimaryImage(product, product.name);
127	  if (!primaryImage) return null;
128	
129	  return {
130	    // Reads productId, not the SDK Product's own `id` — see RecentlyViewedProduct.productId's
131	    // own comment for why (guaranteed equal in practice, but productId is the field the real
132	    // runtime hook explicitly produces this way).
133	    id: product.productId,
134	    href: productUrlBuilder({ id: product.productId }),
135	    name: product.name,
136	    primaryImage,
137	    // No hardcoded fallback currency — if either is absent, skip formatting rather than guess,
138	    // matching productInfo.ts's own "no hardcoded fallback currency" comment.
139	    currentPrice:
140	      typeof product.price === 'number' && product.currency ? formatPrice(product.price, product.currency) : undefined,
141	  };
142	};
